channel.title: GoEasyERP Blog
channel.description: News, release notes and articles from the GoEasyERP project.

item.title: Install GoEasyERP on Windows
item.description: A video showing how to install GoEasyERP on a Windows computer with one PowerShell command and Docker Desktop.

item.title: Cloud ERP and vendor lock-in vs open-source ERP
item.description: Who does the cloud ERP model really benefit, the customer or the vendor? Thoughts on vendor lock-in and what open source can and cannot solve.

item.title: GoEasyERP in 4 minutes
item.description: A short video showing what GoEasyERP covers: the main menu, search with Ctrl+F, keyboard-only sales orders, previewing entries and Navigate.

item.title: What the MIT licence means for GoEasyERP
item.description: GoEasyERP is open source under the MIT licence. What that means: free use, no per-user charges, no lock-in.

item.title: Change the theme and background in GoEasyERP
item.description: GoEasyERP has a dark and a light theme, and the main menu can show a background image of your choice.

item.title: Run GoEasyERP on your Windows workstation
item.description: GoEasyERP runs on a Windows workstation with Docker Desktop. Installation is four PowerShell commands.

item.title: The GoEasyERP live demo is open
item.description: The GoEasyERP live demo is open: a full installation with sample data you can try without installing anything.

item.title: The live demo runs on a Raspberry Pi 5
item.description: The GoEasyERP live demo runs on Kubernetes (k3s) on a Raspberry Pi 5 with 16 GB RAM and an external SSD.
